# Plot

Plot is a movie and television companion for tracking what you watch, keeping a watchlist, writing private notes and ratings, and deciding what to watch next.

The public website explains Plot and its plans. The web app at https://app.theplot.tv is where signed-in members manage their personal viewing journal.

## Public pages

- https://theplot.tv/about: what Plot is and how it works
- https://theplot.tv/plans: Free and Premium plans, prices and the 7-day trial
- https://theplot.tv/changelog: what shipped in Plot, newest first
- https://theplot.tv/privacy: privacy policy
- https://theplot.tv/terms: terms of service
- https://theplot.tv/community: community standards, reporting and blocking

## For agents

- https://theplot.tv/.well-known/api-catalog: the endpoints Plot serves publicly (RFC 9727)
- https://theplot.tv/api/openapi.json: what they accept and return
- https://theplot.tv/api/docs.md: the same, in prose
- https://theplot.tv/auth.md: what can and cannot be authenticated to
- https://theplot.tv/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json: skills for working with Plot
- https://theplot.tv/sitemap-titles.xml: every film and TV page Plot publishes
- https://theplot.tv/sitemap-articles.xml: every What's On piece

## Agent guidance

Plot's public endpoints cover newsletter signup only. There is no public API for member data: do not imply access to a member's watch history, lists, ratings, or account without that member's authenticated, explicit permission. See https://theplot.tv/auth.md.
